baseline.description: No change: keep the current setup
baseline.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a Waffle Cone air purifier. A cylindrical home air purifier with a 3-in-1 filter, a motor and fan, power, converter and control boards, a dust sensor and a moulded plastic body. The Waffle Cone air purifier is assembled in Indonesia using components sourced from Indonesia and China.

The motor, fan and filters are produced in Indonesia. The power board, converter board and control PCB assemblies and dust sensor, power cable, LED light strip and wiring are sourced from China. 

Final assembly in Indonesia: pre-assemble the control, power and sensor sub-assemblies; install frame, fan and motor, filters, boards and housing; test and pack.

prediction.decisive_step: Production of the motor, fan, and filters, combined with the final assembly in Indonesia
prediction.reasoning: Consistent with CBP precedent on air purifiers (e.g., H323218, N359250, N359251), the essential character of an air purifier is imparted by the components that draw in and filter the air—specifically the motor, fan, and filter. Here, the motor, fan, and filters are all produced in Indonesia, and final assembly of all components into the finished unit also takes place in Indonesia. The Chinese-origin PCBs and sensors are substantially transformed during the Indonesian manufacturing and assembly operations.

rejected.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a Waffle Cone air purifier. A cylindrical home air purifier with a 3-in-1 filter, a motor and fan, power, converter and control boards, a dust sensor and a moulded plastic body. The Waffle Cone air purifier is assembled in Indonesia using components sourced from China.

The motor, fan, filters, power board, converter board and control PCB assemblies and dust sensor, power cable, LED light strip and wiring are produced in China. 

In China, the motor, fan and filters will be produced in-house: stamp rotor laminations from silicon steel; stack laminations and wind the rotor; build the stator; assemble the motor; press-fit the fan to the motor spindle (assumed from the product-family template; no operations were supplied for this group).

In China, the housing moulding will be produced in-house: injection-mould the plastic housing parts.

Final assembly in Indonesia: pre-assemble the control, power and sensor sub-assemblies; install frame, fan and motor, filters, boards and housing; test and pack.

key_factors: The Chinese-origin motor, fan, 3-in-1 filter, PCB assemblies, and housing, which together constitute all functional and structural components of the air purifier.
prediction.decisive_step: Manufacturing of the electric motor (stamping, stacking, winding), fan, filters, PCB assemblies, and molded housing in China.
prediction.reasoning: All critical components imparting the essential character of the air purifier—the motor, fan, 3-in-1 filter, PCB assemblies, sensor, and plastic housing—are entirely manufactured in China. Unlike N359250 or N357771 where substantial component manufacturing (such as motor lamination stamping/winding or major subassembly production) occurred in the final assembly country, the operations in Indonesia consist merely of screwing/fitting pre-made Chinese modules together. This simple assembly does not substantially transform the Chinese components.

verdict.reasoning: In air purifier rulings (N359672, N359250, N359251, H323218), CBP confers origin on the assembly country only when local component manufacturing (such as the motor, fan, filter, or injection-molded plastic housing) is combined with assembly. In Variant A, the motor, fan, and filters are made in Indonesia, conferring Indonesian origin. In Variant B, ALL components—including the motor, fan, filters, PCBs, sensor, and injection-molded plastic housing—are produced in China, leaving only simple sub-assembly and final assembly of wholly Chinese parts in Indonesia. Without any Indonesian component manufacturing, assembly alone does not substantially transform the Chinese components.
